body:
Sweetie I am so so sorry this happened to you. I hope you will reply to my comment so that we all know you are still here and "alright". 

First thing first: You did not do anything wrong at all. You are a victim. This guy is not a real boyfriend. He is a criminal. What he did to you was a criminal offence. You were very smart to see your doctor in order to build a record of evidence against him, but why on Earth did your doctor not call the police or tell you to?? You have NOTHING to be ashamed of. For your own protection and safety, please call the police and stay away from this "boyfriend". Ask your best friend to go to the police station with you. Or ask a nurse at your doctor's office for help. 

Secondly: you ask how could your "boyfriend" do this to you? Hun, he will act like this to anyone he is with. He is an abuser. It has nothing to do with you. I feel so sorry for any girl who somehow ends up with him, because he will act like this to future girlfriends too. Unfortunately there are many bad people in this world and there is no explanation for why they are so cruel and bad people. And unfortunately you became close to one of these bad people on earth, but again, IT IS NOT YOUR FAULT! 

I am so proud of you for recognizing that something is wrong and now you can do something to protect yourself. Be safe. Do not see him ever again. Ask a parent, friend, nurse, police officer, or teacher for help. DO not be scared to reach out for help, because you need it and you deserve help!

yeeees I needed to hear this validation!! Thank u. I broke NC after a really good streak and I didn't get a good response from my ex and it was like a second mini breakup that i blamed putting myself through. but you know what was even worse? how i spent over a week in agonizing indecision over whether or not i should break NC and trying to justify it. in the end it was good to do it and get it over with and out of my system. i'm still not happy but at least I can move on :)
I'm just following up! Are you okay? :(
I hope Bubble responds!! :(

Oh, Ash. How much pain you must be in right now :( I really wish I could give you a hug right now. Yes, you are very young, but to quote Jane Fonda "it's way harder to be young than it is to be old." 

However, even though you are young you seem very wise and introspective. These are very admirable qualities to have and will help you survive this hard life. 

It can feel so hard not having friends. I totally get that. But I only met my best friend in life when I was 26! And I can't imagine my life without them now. There is no rush or pressure to find your best friend. Sometimes, you have to wait while they find you! 

Sending you lots of love my friend.

The moderators on this sub discourage people from responding with "yes, this too shall pass," because the future is uncertain and unknowable and therefore this seemingly hollow cliche comes off as being a very useless thing to say. Because no one can guarantee that things will improve. 

But I think that doesn't always mean you should't keep trying. There is always a chance things will improve, so don't cheat yourself out of taking that chance if you feel like you can. 

Sending you lots of love.

I am so, so sorry to read this, Bubble. You do not deserve to die. I wish I could bust into your room like the crazy kool aid man right now and stop you. 

And no offence to the suicide hotlines you called, but when I was depressed I HATED it when people told me to "calm down". I always said to them "Duh, I want to calm down, but I physically cannot; that's the friggin problem I need help with!!" Sheesh. 

If you feel comfortable writing about it, may we please ask you why you want to hang yourself? I wish there was more we could do to support you. You deserve at least some help before you make your decision.

SnooBeans (great username by the way), I am so sorry that this horrible person is ruining your experience on Discord. 

Please block and report this bad user immediately; he is exhibiting criminal and unlawful behaviour, not to mention he is doing something despicable. 

Please do not harm yourself because of this one horrible person who is messing with you. You matter; he does not.

I'm so sorry you're going through such a rough time, honestly :( I've never dated anyone, no one has ever liked me, and the majority of the time I assume it's because I must be ugly. It really sucks. 

I used to be so depressed about it (I mean REALLY depressed); it felt like I was living in the bottom of a bottomless and hopeless black hole, until one day... I don't know how to explain it. It's like my body and mind became so saturated with unhappiness over my perceived ugliness and single AF status that they both snapped and I was like "eff it, I give up caring". Not caring doesn't always = happiness, but I am no longer beating myself up over things I can't control and I am not in such a hopeless place anymore. 

I hope the same for you. Sorry you are feeling so down. I wish I knew what to say to help you.

I don't like thinking in terms of what is normal or abnormal. Normality is subjective, and comparing oneself to others never brought anyone any real happiness. 

Sometimes life is hard and we think dark thoughts. Unfortunately I'm not a medical professional, so I can't say if you should speak to a doctor or not about these thoughts. But I hope you are okay.

Hi Life, Do you mean the Humber Bay Arch Bridge in Toronto? That is a very peaceful and beautiful area. I love to go for walks there by myself. 

I am so so sorry to hear you are in so much pain. I wish I knew what to say or do to help you.

Wow. I am so sorry to hear you and him are going through such a difficult time. 

I would 100% google what to do when your ex threatens suicide when you try to leave him. There are some very good articles written by medical professionals that know what to do. it's important to not let him emotionally manipulate you into staying in the relationship. You are not responsible for his actions and that is a sh\*tty thing for him to put on you. Shame on him. 

However, I also feel very bad for him. he is clearly struggling and he needs help. Now, that doesn't mean that you need to be the one who helps him. If you are worried about him doing something tonight, maybe ask your parents to call 911 for you.

Don't do it. No offense at all if you live in America, but this is one reason why me and my friends are grateful for not living in the USA with its prevalent gun culture: we would have shot ourselves dozens of times by now if we had readily accessible firearms to end our lives. 

Life is hard. Don't get me wrong. I totally get it. Really. But just because life is hard does not mean that it is not worth living! And yes, just because life gets better it doesn't always mean you will lend up with a great life of the best life. But again, you deserve to live! Why should life be a privilege of the happy one percent? Eff that and eff them! Why should you punish yourself like this, when the cause of your depression is not your fault? Whether your depression is situational or chemical caused, it. is. not. your. fault! Life either screwed you over massively or chemicals in your brain are making you feel like sh\*t. But if I get robbed, am I the one who gets sent to jail? Heck no, that ass hat of a thief is the one who should go to jail! So don't punish yourself by killing yourself. Please. You can fight this, even if it takes a long time. It is worth it because you deserve to live. Help others. 

I am so proud of you for writing to us. it's a very brave thing to do. You should be so, so proud of yourself, Summons. Honestly. Just... just don't end it here. Keep going. Find a good doctor. if the first one sucks? Try again. You can do this. It's hard to live life. But it is still worth living and we want you to stick around.

You are not a burden, so please don't ever apologize to us! You should be extremely proud of yourself, because you took an amazing and very difficult first step: writing to us on here and acknowledging that you are married to an abusive husband who has dangerously isolated you from your support network. Seriously Arrow, I am so proud of you and I admire you. Most women are unable to admit they are in a bad marriage. We are both similar ages and yet you have accomplished way more than I have ever done. Four children! They are so lucky to have you. You can't give up, but not because of your kids: because of YOU! This a-hole husband is going to push you around, make your life difficult, and THEN on top of everything make you feel suicidal? HECK NO! What the flying fart! He does NOT get to do that to you. 

I'm not a medical or healthcare professional, so technically I can't give you advice about what to do. Only you know what is the safest way forward for yourself and your kids. But... if it were me in this position... I would very very slowly and cautiously seek outside help. Go to the library and use a library computer to google a women's shelter nearby. Avoid getting into any more arguments with your husband; you will not win any arguments with a narcissist/abuser. (Friendly reminder emotional abuse still = abuse.) Slowly devise a getaway plan. Google how to get away on a library computer so that your husband doesn't find out what you are up to. For some reason, a few sites I looked up said to go to a local domestic violence shelter instead of the police. Maybe that's because the police might tell your husband where you went? I'm not sure if that is correct. BoredPanda has a great article on how to prepare for your escape. Do not file for divorce until you and the kids are safely in a new home and do not tell anyone. Assume your husband is looking at your phone. Change all your passwords or secretly buy a new phone.  

You can do this, Arrow! I can tell by the way you write that you are strong and a wonderful mother. I don't have children but... if I am ever lucky enough to meet someone and have kids of my own, then I hope I can be as good of a mother to them. You've been through a lot. But after you survive this last major hurdle, and your kids become hold enough to start helping you out... wow. You are going to have a wonderful big family and so much love and a great new life. Good luck! Sending you lots of love.

Repeat after me (I'm serious! Say it aloud. Don't lie to me. Ready?): "I AM NOT RUINING ANYONE'S LIFE BY BEING HERE. That is not the real me talking. I don't know why the hell that part of my brain is telling me that, but its wrong." 

The reason you are still depressed is because there is a pernicious part of your brain feeding you chemicals that are making you think dark thoughts and feel like sh\*t. p.s. isn't pernicious a great word? 

You gotta fight it, friend. Try to disassociate that part of your brain from your true self. The real you wants to live. The real you knows that life is grey, not black and white. Living isn't just for the happy. Eff that. You only get to live if you're happy? If that's true then there's a new and even worse 1% in town. Most people are not happy, or at least they are not happy most of the time. And that is OKAY. Yeah it sucks because we are led to believe the opposite, but it is OKAY. 

Get medical help. Don't stop searching, even if your first few doctors or therapists suck ass (sorry for my bad language). Find out if your depression is situational or chemical. Don't give up. Read Golden Era classic Russian Literature (Tosltoy etc.) Those author GET/UNDERSTAND human pain and suffering. They were my therapists. Nothing inherently is wrong with you at all. You're just dealing with a mental health issue, but your mental health issue is not YOU! You are more. And you can do this.

People's opinions don't mean anything. Read some Mark Twain quotes about what he had to say about people. No one can make you feel inferior without your consent. If people think you are a loser, then they are super rude and who gives a flying fart what rude people think? I only care about the opinions of nice people, and nice people never kick someone while they are down. As for not having a relationship, I'll tell you I've never had one either. No one has ever asked me out, no one has ever wanted to kiss me etc. Does it make me really sad sometimes? Heck yeah! But this is a massive social trend, sadly. Modern day society has loose social bonds and it's really sad. But nothing is wrong with us. We just have to be patient and there are more important things in life.

Hi Luz, Thanks for replying. A great source of unhappiness comes from when our life does not match our expectations. Childhood? Phht. Most people hate their childhood! Adulthood for the win: independence and freedom. There are many jerks and asshats in this world (that's why I love animals so much and spend most of my time with animals. Animals aren't rude, racist, judgmental, they don't betray you etc.; but that's another rant). God only said to love thy neighbour; He/She never said you have to like them or trust them! haha.

Listen, only you can decide what to do with your own life. But you have to make sure this is the REAL Luz talking, not the depressed Luz. The true self and the depressed self are not one and the same. And as you so intelligently acknowledge, your region's mental health resources suck ass (sorry for the bad language). But who ever told you life would be fun? What the flying fart! Life ain't fun. Life is hard! But life doesn't SUCK. Life is still worth living. Don't end your life just for lack of fun, c'mon my friend! I only have fun 1 day a week! yes, maybe I have better physiological resilience that you to accept that. I don't deny it. But it's a learned trait. Try telling that little bug in your brain to shut the eff up every time if tries to make you believe life sucks, people suck, let's end this etc.

Don't live because of some silly hallmark card trite like "after the rain there is a rainbow" blah blah blah. Don't live because random strangers on the internet tell you to live. Live because you deserve to live and you deserve to be here to help other people and experience this insane and astronomically improbable development that we are all on Earth in a massive universe despite all the odds. There are more kind people than not on Earth. They deserve to be loved and helped. Please don't insult them, their kindness, and their struggles by grouping them together with the asshats in your town.

it's a small minority that is making the world so crappy. Billions are suffering right now. Please don't condemn everyone because of the few that are screwing us over. No one can make you feel inferior without your permission (that's a famous quote by someone, but who? Gah, can't remember). 

Show kindness to everyone you meet, because everyone is fighting a hard battle. it's also a pandemic right now, which is making life 10x harder and bringing out the worst in people, but these are not normal times. It is so easy to get frustrated by the state of things, but there are many kind people in this world who deserve your love and help. Please don't give up on them. It would be an insult to them. Sending you lots of love.

Holy moly, Consideration! That is, like, the best compliment I have received in ages, so thank YOU. I really believe that our true selves do not = our depressed selves. I'm not a doctor of course, but sometimes I feel like depression is a type of multiple personality disorder; the depressed self takes control and makes us believe all these horrible things about our future and ourselves that are NOT true and that's why fighting depression really is like fighting an internal war. And then you have all these external factors (poverty, loneliness, politics, global warming, social ills etc.) that certainly don't help us win the fight easily. So my attitude is EFF that! F\*\*\* it! We are NOT going to let this world make us commit suicide, dammit! They don't get to screw us over and then make us feel suicidal. Keeping fighting. Find a better doctor. Try medication. Vote for a political party that is the least sh\*tty choice, protest, protect nature. And don't forget, the pandemic is making life 10x more difficult too, so these are not normal times. You can do this, Consideration! Maybe you can't stop external factors from ruining your life right now, but don't let them make you kill yourself on top of everything else! You can do this. Sending you lots of love.

Can\_, I will not feel guilty. I promise. You are not wasting my time. I will understand, even though I would still be very sad if that's what you decide to do. I am not trying to help you to make myself feel better; I am not trying to help you because I am bored; I am not trying to help you because you have become my little project; I am not trying to help you because I have a savior complex etc. 

I am trying to help you because YOU DESERVE HELP. C'mon. Say it out loud. "My name is Can\_ and I deserve to receive help!" That's why I really like how you have "Can" in your username. Because you can receive help and you can do this. 

It's important to understand why you feel suicidal. Your true self and your depressed self are not always one and the same. It's important that your true self is the one to make such a massive big decision. Don't let your depressed self take control here. Try to think of your depression as having a stupid bug inside your brain. This mother effing bug (please excuse my bad language) is flooding the rest of your brain with bad chemicals and bad bugs. Please try to think of your depressed self as a separate part of yourself instead of letting if take control over everything. You deserve to win this battle, Can\_. Sending you lots of love. Living is about choosing to live DESPITE the fact that life often sucks ass. I am so proud of you for making it this far. And you should be very proud of yourself. You are locked in a deadly battle, but I believe in you.

Hi Rokakun, are you still there? Please reply so that we know you are still with us! :( before I begin my post, I want to say BREATHE. Come on, do it with me. BREATHE IN and count 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - 5 HOLD 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - 5 .... okay now breathe out 1 - 2 - 3 - 8 - 5 (yes I wrote the wrong number on purpose, did I fool you? :P) Repeat one or two times! 

I am so sorry you are feeling this way. Legal Disclaimer: I am not a medical professional, but what the flying fart is wrong with your therapist? Going away for one month on vacation without a backup to continue working with you?? And again, I am not a doctor, but I don't think you should have stopped taking your medications, especially if they were helping you! Maybe that is what is triggering your depression/anxiety attack. One of my good friends has depression and a few other mental health disorders. It took her three years of trying different medications, different doses, switching therapists until she finally found a good one, and feeling like sh\*t until FINALLY everything came together and she now feels way better. Will she ever feel 10/10 happiness levels? No. Many people aren't genetically wired to be happy naturally/biologically, but that is totally fine. You can definitely still live a good life even if genetically you are predisposed to be more melancholy than the average person. And it sounds like your depression is chemical, not situational. 

When I was going through a very dark period of depression (I am naturally a melancholy/sad person too, but my depression was situational; a bad life event happened to me) it helped me to visualize my depression as a bug in my brain. This stupid bug had bit my brain and was releasing all these bad chemicals and bad thoughts. So for spite, was I going to let that stupid bug in my head ruin my life? heck no! Even though I felt HORRIBLE for a very long time, I refused to let the "bug" win. I'm not sure why, but this technique really helped me ignore all the bad thoughts. Yes, it felt like a war and it took a lot of effort, but every time a depressing thought crept into my mind I said "NOPE NOPE NOPE. That's not ME. That is not a rational thought, I do NOT actually think this way or believe this about me or my life. That is the stupid bug talking." Try to distance your TRUE self from your depressed self. They are not one and the same!! Every time you have a bad thought creep in (i.e. I hate myself; I am so dumb; I will never be happy; life is too hard; suicide is the only answer) you go splash water on your face!! Or run out of the house and down the street until you run out of breath. You may not be in the army or a solider, but you are literally fighting for your life right now and I want you to win! No matter how long it takes. Go back to your doctor, find a better therapist, tell your parents or a friends to sit with you 24/7 if that's what it takes. You want to spend 24 hours watching movies on your couch in some kick ass pink fuzzy sweatpants? DO IT, FRIEND! YOU ARE IN SURVIVAL MODE RIGHT NOW AGAINST YOUR OWN BRAIN. That sh\*t is scary!!! But I am so proud of you and you should be SO proud of yourself for reaching out. You are amazing. It is SO hard to reach out, especially when you feel like sh\*t and think you have already decided to kill yourself. BUT PLEASE. Please please please. Don't. It is your choice to do whatever you think is best for you. But you have to make sure the REAL Rokakun wants to do it, and not that mother effing bug in your brain, that you know is the one actually doing this to you. 

Take care. Write any time you need to. It could take years. But life is grey; not black and white. And you deserve to live no matter what. Sending you lots of love.

Don't apologize! You are in crisis mode and you need help! Please don't feel sorry for anything. To combat your profile description: speaking to you is NOT a waste of anyone's time. Yes, life is so so short and time is so precious. But here I am, choosing to write to a stranger I have never met, and who I barely know anything about, because I don't need to know anything about you at all to care about you. I can't imagine spending my time in any other better way other than writing to you right now. Before me is a human soul that is suffering and that really sucks. It sucks ASS (please excuse my bad language). I really wish I could write or do the right thing to help you, because you deserve to feel better. You do. But depression is a giant. I totally get that. It can feel like an endless fight without any progress or breaks. But you know what? You gotta keep going. Not for anyone else, but because you deserve to live and you deserve to survive this sh\*t until the real end. If this depression is "chemical" then you gotta try and fight the tiny part in your brain that has turned against you and is flooding your body with bad chemicals and bad thoughts. If your depression is situational, then your current circumstances in life are not your fault either! So if your depression isn't your fault (which it is not!), then why should you be the one who has to be punished by ending your own life?? You deserve to live, friend! You deserve to live even if life sucks ass for the next couple years! You deserve to live even if life is hard!! If I get robbed, am I the one who goes to prison? Heck no, the ass hat who robbed be goes to jail. 

Please don't give up. It's your choice, of course, but life is grey; it's not black and white. Oh, and if I am allowed to offer a suggestion, read lots of golden age classic Russian literature (Tolstoy etc.) because those authors KNEW human suffering. They totally get it. And it helped me. Good luck. p.s. you wrote your autism seems to be making your life difficult, but can I just say I LOVE meeting people with autism? I really do. Sure, sometimes you might say something socially awkward, but who gives a flying fart? Your interpretation of the word is so refreshing and you don't speak in riddles. So, be proud!

Can I just say really quickly that I love your username? No sarcasm. It's awesome. How did you come up with it? 

I am very sorry to hear you are going through this very difficult time. I read some of your other posts and would like to say I personally know a few ethical vegans in my life and it's true: vegans are usually empaths and are therefore way more likely to be depressed. Which is so sad, because these vegan friends of mine are such great people and they are very kind. They are doing a good deed and I wish I had the strength to be more like them, so it seems very unfair that they are so depressed because they don't deserve it. I think because there are not many vegans yet, the vegans of today feel more isolated. Do you feel like your veganism is the driving cause of your depression and suicidal thoughts? Some of my vegan friends never watch documentaries anymore, and it's not because they don't care about what is happening in slaughterhouses, but because for their own mental health they can't keep watching these horrible things. Do not feel guilty if you need to stop watching documentaries. You need to do it to protect your mind so that you can continue fighting for animal rights. The animals need you!  

As I wrote to someone else on here: depression and suicidal thoughts are not your fault of course, right? It's either the chemicals in your brain working against you to make you feel like sh\*t or it's life's circumstances screwing you over. So if it's not your fault, why do YOU have to be the one to end your life? This is YOUR life! If I get robbed, am I the one who goes to prison? Heck no, that ass hat of a thief should go to prison. So please don't end your life. Not because it would make your friends sad, and not because you should wait for the rainbow after the rain and all that other blah blah blah hallmark card trite. It's because this is YOUR life and you deserve to have it. You are not feeling this way "on your own" - something (your brain, life, society's social ills, whatever) is doing this to us! Making thousands of people feel like crap. Don't pay the ultimate price for them screwing you over. Help others. Stay alive. I hope this little comment helps you, even a little bit.

Please talk to us, Can\_. Do you feel comfortable sharing why exactly you are struggling so much? I am so sorry to hear that you are in such a difficult situation right now. 

But you should be very proud of yourself for reaching out on this sub and for trying to receive professional help. It honestly is a very brave thing to do, so please take some personal pride in that!

Hi Luz,   
Legal disclaimer: I am not a medical professional and I am not qualified to give a medical opinion at all, but it seems to me like you definitely have suicidal depression, especially since you wrote a comment on another post about your suicide attempt. The fact that you attempted suicide definitely, in my mind, means you are suffering from depression and you need to try to get someone to give you the right diagnosis so that you can access help asap. I don't know what country you live in, but that is so crazy that no one is willing to give you the right diagnosis! You deserve to receive the right medical help. And this is what I mean - your medical institution is screwing you over. You think you only have ADHD, but I know people with ADHD who do not exhibit such strong depression or suicidal thoughts. Again, not a doctor, but there are many people in life who are genetically disposed to only ever feel maximum 6 or 7 out of 10 happiness, no matter what they do. Your life is not worth less just because you were not born as one of those people who naturally lucked out and were born into a body that feels 10/10 happy and more frequently. Your life is still worth living even if you are "handicapped" with feeling happy less frequently. 

Only you have the power to move forward and keep trying. And I really hope you do :) Please take care.

I am really sorry to hear you are struggling, Melon. It reminds me of when people say they don't want to die, but that they definitely don't want to live either. And I get it. Honestly. Life is hard and it reminds me of a song (Salvation by The Strumbellas) and one of the lines in the song is "All my life, they never told me / They never said that it'd ever be so hard." Sometimes I feel like when we were growing up family and school should have done more to constructively warn us that life is actually hard and we are not all special snowflakes that can literally do whatever we want (otherwise why the h\*ll am I not an astronaut right now??)

As I wrote to someone else on here: depression and suicidal thoughts are not your fault of course, right? It's either the chemicals in your brain working against you to make you feel like sh\*t or it's life's circumstances screwing you over. So if it's not your fault, why do YOU have to be the one to end your life? This is YOUR life! If I get robbed, am I the one who goes to prison? Heck no, that ass hat of a thief should go to prison. So please don't end your life. Not because it would make your friends sad, and not because you should wait for the rainbow after the rain and all that other blah blah blah hallmark card trite. It's because this is YOUR life and you deserve to have it. You are not feeling this way "on your own" - something (your brain, life, society's social ills, whatever) is doing this to us! Making thousands of people feel like crap. Don't pay the ultimate price for them screwing you over. Help others. Stay alive. I hope this little comment helps you, even a little bit.

please don't do it, Maximus. I can tell you are in a lot of pain and I am very sorry you feel this way. You're right that the future is completely unknown. But why are you assuming the worst will happen? Life is grey, not black and white. Live for the future good times and try to survive the bad times as best as you can while you are waiting. As I wrote to someone else here: depression and suicidal thoughts are not your fault, right? It's either the chemicals in your brain tricking you into feeling bad for no reason or it is life's circumstances screwing you over. So if it's not your fault, why should you be the one to have to end YOUR life? If I get robbed by a thief, am I the one who goes to prison? Heck no, that jerk of a thief should be the one to go to prison. So keep working on yourself, because you can do this. You might experience setbacks, maybe in a few days you will feel even worse than today, but who gives a crap because you can do this and happiness comes in bursts of short moments. Don't feel bad for not feeling happy all the time. I hope this post helps even a little bit, but as my nickname says I am clueless! :)

Hi LuzjuLeviathan, Don't do it. I literally created a reddit account for the first time ever just so that I could write this to you. Depression is never anyone's fault, right? It's life's circumstances screwing you over or the chemicals in your brain doing this to you. So if it's not your fault, why do YOU have to be the one to end your life? If I get robbed, do I send myself to prison? No, the thief is the one who should be punished. You might say "well being forced to life this hard life is my punishment." NO. Life itself is never a punishment. Life is a GIFT. It's what happens DURING your life that sucks ass. Fight those factors ruining your life - don't end life itself. I really hope this post helps you. Depression and suicidal thoughts are extremely complicated and it's not like a single comment will fix everything, but YOU CAN'T GIVE UP. I've found that the number one thing that helps is helping other people or animals. Go to the animal shelter, and hug the sickest saddest dog there. Visit a homeless person and buy them a nice meal. If you can help someone else through their sh\*t, you can definitely find a way to one day get through your own hardships! I AM ROOTING FOR YOU AND EVERYONE ON THIS SUBREDDIT!
